notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}{U}.
Vedalkan Mastermind and Elvish Piper do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{U}.
Activate Elvish Piper by paying {G} and tapping it, putting Village Bell-Ringer from your hand onto the battlefield.
Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Vedalken Mastermind by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Village Bell-Ringer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If you can produce at least one additional mana in step 1, this combo produces infinite mana.
